##### Project general facts

Ocean Tower by Ahmed Al Ansari Real Estate Development is a contemporary residential tower that combines a refined waterfront lifestyle with a resort-style amenity offering. The building rises above a ground floor and a two-level parking podium to a rooftop, standing taller than many neighbouring buildings and occupying an unusually large plot. The project offers one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments, with selected residences opening towards ocean views and a sky lounge providing elevated vistas across the surrounding waterfront.

Amenities are designed around relaxation, wellness and an active lifestyle. Residents can enjoy a lazy river, an infinity swimming pool and a jacuzzi, alongside a sauna, indoor and outdoor gyms and an outdoor yoga area. Sports facilities include a padel tennis court, a badminton court, table tennis and a dedicated jogging track. Families benefit from a kids' playground with a sand area and mini golf, while a billiards room and lounge areas create relaxed spaces for socialising with friends and neighbours.

Interiors feature contemporary finishes and high-quality materials, with bright living spaces planned around comfort and everyday practicality. Kitchens are fully equipped with fitted appliances, ready for daily cooking and entertaining. Bedrooms offer calm, private retreats, and bathrooms are finished with modern fixtures and fittings. Residences are delivered with fitted kitchens and without furniture, giving owners the flexibility to personalise their interiors to their own taste and style.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Islands is a coastal master community by Nakheel on the Deira waterfront, combining an extensive public beachfront, marinas, golf courses, a community park and a wide choice of resorts and hotels. The islands offer a relaxed, resort-style environment with sunset views across the water. A waterfront marina with space for restaurants and cafes sits close to many residential plots, adding a lively setting by the water.

The Infinity Bridge links the islands to the mainland, placing Al Mamzar Beach, Deira City Centre, the Gold Souq and Dubai Hospital a short drive away. Dubai International Airport is also within easy reach, and the wider road network connects residents with Downtown Dubai, Business Bay and the rest of the city. Beaches, waterfront dining and hotels on the islands keep leisure close to home, while schools, clinics and supermarkets in neighbouring Deira cover everyday needs.

Dubai Islands is a freehold destination that appeals to end users seeking beachfront living close to the city and to investors focused on premium rental demand. Its resort-style setting, marinas and proximity to the airport support both long-term and holiday rentals. As one of Dubai's key coastal master plans, the community offers strong potential for long-term value, supported by growing hospitality and leisure infrastructure across the islands.
